signature.name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
signature.detail: The city's defining experience and the reason many people come to Chengdu: you can watch giant pandas up close, including playful cubs. Go early in the morning when the pandas are most active and feeding, and book tickets in advance, especially on weekends and holidays.

signature.name: Jinli Ancient Street
signature.detail: A lively restored old street with traditional architecture, snacks and souvenir stalls, and it is the most famous stroll in the city. Visit in the late afternoon or evening when the lanterns come on, and expect crowds.

signature.name: Wuhou Shrine
signature.detail: A historic shrine complex dedicated to Zhuge Liang and the Three Kingdoms era, set in peaceful gardens next to Jinli. It pairs naturally with a Jinli visit; go on a weekday morning for quieter paths.

signature.name: Du Fu Thatched Cottage
signature.detail: The former residence of the great Tang poet Du Fu, now a serene museum and garden. It is a calm, green escape from the city center; allow an hour or two and go in the morning.

signature.name: Wenshu Monastery
signature.detail: A working Buddhist monastery in the old city with incense-filled halls, tea houses and a vegetarian restaurant. It is easy to reach by metro and makes a relaxed half-day with nearby streets.

signature.name: People's Park
signature.detail: The classic Chengdu park where locals drink tea, play mahjong and watch the world go by. Come in the afternoon, order a cup of tea at a teahouse and simply people-watch.

signature.name: Tianfu Square
signature.detail: The central square and a handy orientation point in the modern city, with the Mao statue and metro interchange. It is a quick stop rather than a long visit; combine it with nearby shopping streets.

signature.name: Qingcheng Mountain
signature.detail: A Taoist mountain outside the city with temples, forest trails and views, a popular day trip from Chengdu. Wear comfortable shoes and start early, as the full climb takes most of a day.
